plan.title: Upcoming serial-auction line item is view-only

steps.note: Open an existing live event with bids and a serial-auction line item.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's pricing view so the vendor can see the line items and bidding controls.
Assert that an upcoming line item is visible to the vendor.
Assert that the vendor cannot submit a bid while the displayed round is not actionable.
